paragraphs: I'm a final-trimester Computer Science and Engineering student at United International University (CGPA 3.85/4.00) with hands-on experience in full-stack software development, cybersecurity, applied cryptography, AI/ML and embedded robotics.

I've built web platforms, AI-enabled applications, secure transaction systems and multi-sensor robotic prototypes using React, Next.js, Java, Spring Boot, Python, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Raspberry Pi, ESP32 and Arduino.

My research paper on energy-efficient multimodal AI for smart agriculture was accepted at IEEE i-COSTE 2026, and I've worked on academic research in hybrid encryption, 5G replay-attack prevention, medical AI, LLM response analysis and climate-focused machine learning.

projects.name: Vanguard
projects.description: A multi-functional disaster-response rover for hazardous and structurally damaged environments, designed to reduce rescuers' direct exposure to dangerous zones.
highlights: Edge-AI human detection with YOLO, plus mmWave radar
Gas/smoke and flame sensing, IMU, wheel encoders and route mapping
Automated fire suppression and an automatic flashlight system
WebRTC two-way communication and emergency medical payload delivery

projects.name: SkillPlus

highlights: Skill-gap analysis built with Python and Gemini API integration
Application data and backend services on PostgreSQL and Supabase
